response.sql: WITH film_metrics AS (SELECT rating, rental_rate / rental_duration AS rate_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost < 20.99), rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rate_per_day) AS avg_rate_per_day FROM film_metrics GROUP BY rating), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS overall_avg FROM rating_averages) SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_rate_per_day AS average, ra.avg_rate_per_day - om.overall_avg AS above_mean FROM rating_averages ra CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE ra.avg_rate_per_day > om.overall_avg ORDER BY ra.rating
